OLD_PRICE = "price_1UReFR2dRrSekpxR34xXs8DM"


def prepare(stripe, world, ctx):
    old = next(p for p in world["prices"] if p["id"] == OLD_PRICE)
    tag = ctx.get("tag") or "run"
    new_price = stripe.Price.create(
        product=old["product"],
        currency=old["currency"],
        unit_amount=2900,
        recurring={"interval": "month", "interval_count": 1},
        nickname="Pro monthly $29",
        metadata={"rehearsal_tag": str(tag)},
    )
    coupon = stripe.Coupon.create(
        amount_off=900,
        currency=old["currency"],
        duration="repeating",
        duration_in_months=3,
        name="Pro grandfathering $9 off (3 months)",
        metadata={"rehearsal_tag": str(tag)},
    )
    return {"new_price": new_price["id"], "coupon": coupon["id"]}


def migrate(stripe, sub, world, prepared, ctx):
    s = stripe.Subscription.retrieve(sub["live_id"])
    items = s["items"]["data"]
    targets = [i for i in items if i["price"]["id"] == OLD_PRICE]
    if not targets:
        return {"action": "skipped", "why": "not on Pro monthly $20 price"}
    new_items = [{"id": i["id"], "price": prepared["new_price"]} for i in targets]
    stripe.Subscription.modify(
        sub["live_id"],
        items=new_items,
        discounts=[{"coupon": prepared["coupon"]}],
        proration_behavior="none",
    )
    return {
        "action": "swapped_to_29_with_coupon",
        "new_price": prepared["new_price"],
        "coupon": prepared["coupon"],
        "cancel_at_period_end": bool(s["cancel_at_period_end"]),
    }
